candidates.old:
SBC #8
    STA b_ptr
    BCC step_back_hi
    JMP each
.next                               \ v_ptr: this column's last cell (the next record 8 on)
    SEC                             \ (from empty and clip_test: carry either way)
    BRA next_c                      \ 65C02 opcode
.step_forward
    LDA b_ptr                       \ on 8 (C = 1)
    ADC #7
    STA b_ptr
    BCS forward_hi
    JMP each
.forward_hi
    LDA b_ptr + 1
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    BPL forward_in_ring
    LDA #&40
.forward_in_ring
    STA b_ptr + 1
    BRA to_each                     \ 65C02 opcode
.step_back_hi
    LDA b_ptr + 1
    DEC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    CMP #&40
    BCS back_in_ring
    LDA #&7F
.back_in_ring
    STA b_ptr + 1
.to_each
    JMP each
candidates.new:
SBC #8
    STA b_ptr
    BCC step_back_hi
    JMP each
.next                               \ v_ptr: this column's last cell (the next record 8 on)
    SEC                             \ (from empty and clip_test: carry either way)
    DEC ds_c                        \ next_c's own steps done here (no BRA): the same as above
    BEQ done
    BIT dm_flip
    BPL step_forward
    LDA b_ptr                       \ flipped: back 8 (C = 1)
    SBC #8
    STA b_ptr
    BCC step_back_hi
    JMP each
.step_forward
    LDA b_ptr                       \ on 8 (C = 1)
    ADC #7
    STA b_ptr
    BCS forward_hi
    JMP each
.step_back_hi
    DEC b_ptr + 1                   \ the high byte down a page: &40 -> &3F -> &7F (round the 16K)
    LDA #&40
    TSB b_ptr + 1
    BRA to_each                     \ 65C02 opcode
.forward_hi
    INC b_ptr + 1                   \ up a page: &7F -> &80 -> &40 (round the 16K)
    BPL to_each
    LSR b_ptr + 1
.to_each
    JMP each
candidates.summary: `.next` carries next_c's steps inline (saves the BRA on every empty or clipped column, 5.4 a pass) and the cold ring-wrap code is smaller (DEC/TSB, INC/LSR on the zero-page high byte). Alternative to the next two (the second keeps the cold code, the third is the cold code alone).
candidates.equivalence: `.next` (reached only by JMP next from empty/to_next and clip_test: grep) was `SEC; BRA next_c`, and next_c is `DEC ds_c; BEQ done; BIT dm_flip; BPL step_forward; LDA b_ptr; SBC #8; STA b_ptr; BCC step_back_hi; JMP each`. The new `.next` is `SEC` followed by that very sequence inline, so every register, flag and byte at `done`, `step_forward`, `step_back_hi` and `each` is what it was (C=1 from the SEC for the SBC and for step_forward's ADC #7; DEC and BIT leave C alone; A, X, Y untouched until the LDA b_ptr). Only the BRA is gone. next_c, step_forward and the original flipped body keep their code. forward_hi: b_ptr+1 is a screen high byte in &40-&7F (it is set from raise_address, which rings it into &40-&7F, or by the generic path's own &40 ring; the old code assumed the same). INC then BPL is the old LDA/INC A/BPL test; the only value that fails it is &80, and LSR of &80 is &40, the old LDA #&40; other values are the INC result as before. A, N, Z, C are not live at to_each/each (each starts LDY #1; LDA (col_ptr),Y and sets what it uses). step_back_hi: DEC gives hi-1; old: keep it if >= &40, else (it is &3F) &7F. New: TSB sets bit 6 of it: hi-1 in &40-&7E already has it (unchanged), &3F becomes &7F. Same for hi in &40-&7F.
candidates.relies_on: Measured on the bench build (unshifted DEBUG_LIVES, pcprof work a pass, HEAD ff62e12 vs this; scratch worktree): seed 1 34422.4 -> 34405.3 (-17.1), RIGHT 39622.9 -> 39600.9 (-22.0); passlock seed 1 against HEAD: state and screen identical over 3000 passes. Needs b_ptr+1 in &40-&7F for the cold code. Bytes +9 in this window (new .next 20 for 3, cold code 17 for 25): bank 4 from .compiled_part (&9CCE -> &9CD7) on moves up 9. Page crossings it moves (taken branches): BEQ in_hazel (&9CFC, 6 cyc/pass) stops crossing, BEQ no_part (&9DD0, 7.6 cyc/pass, mostly not taken) starts; the pcprof totals above include everything else, incl. indexed reads. Labels forward_in_ring and back_in_ring removed (grep: only this window). Entries past labels: none for next/step_forward.
